scenes.say: Picture this. Your neighbor just got solar panels.

lines: Now the salesperson is *at your door.*
scenes.say: And now the same salesperson is knocking on your door.
The big question. Is solar still worth it in twenty twenty-six?
Here's what changed. The thirty percent federal tax credit ended for systems installed after twenty twenty-five.

scenes.kicker: Solar is usually worth it if:
scenes.say: Solar is usually still worth it if: you pay above-average electricity rates. You have a sunny roof. And you plan to stay ten years or more.
Typical payback is now about nine to fourteen years. In high-rate states, it can still be under ten.
Want to know if it's worth it for you? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
